text_block_list.text:
After accepting Eishin Flash's request for 
"special training," we headed to the 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I have been awaiting your arrival. In 
anticipation of this moment, body and mind 
are fully prepared."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let us walk together, then. Along the 
"path to absolute victory."

—Eishin Flash carries an austere, knightly 
air. Coupled with the fact she's in her 
racing silks, I wonder what could be the 
reason...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Is it, strange?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...As I thought, I'm still not ready...! 
—Excuse me!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry. Running away so suddenly 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—It's just... to think that even in your 
eyes, I am still lacking... it made me 
feel rather ashamed...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—About this racing racewear... I've been 
troubled over it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"When having this outfit made, I requested 
design elements that would remind me of my 
homeland."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And the completed racing silks truly 
embodied the master's very soul. I could 
only marvel at how magnificent they turned 
out.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...That is precisely why I feel crushed. 
Under the immense weight of this 
Racewear—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It is the weight of the 'tradition' and 
'pride' of my homeland that I carry upon 
my shoulders when wearing this outfit."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My mother, who raced in my homeland, must 
have felt this exact same weight that I 
feel now, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Am I truly carrying myself in a way that 
befits this outfit?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...That is what I wanted you to see 
today."
choice_data_list: So that's why you wore your Racing Outfit.
So that's why you wore your Racing Outfit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That greeting just now was part of it 
too. Unfortunately, it seems to have 
fallen flat, but—

...I've finally grasped the situation. Now 
then, what she needs right now is—
choice_data_list:
Maybe just run a whole bunch to get used 
to it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I also believe that is 
the proper path.

And so, we decided to have her run in the 
upcoming mock race specifically wearing 
her racing silks. As for the running style 
everyone was curious about—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah!

...Though there were moments where she 
pulled a bit hard, in the end, she 
magnificently seized 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. I'm back."
choice_data_list: ...You don't look very relieved, do you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Partway through, I completely lost 
awareness of it. Whether my actions were 
worthy of bearing this 'pride'—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I just got so caught up in running with 
everything I had—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, not only am I unworthy of 
wearing this outfit, but it would also be 
disrespectful to everyone who fought 
alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...For now, I must at least show proper 
courtesy and offer my greetings to the 
other party."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Thank you very much for joining 
me today. ............It's just that, 
well, today, I—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Flash-san! That was a great match! 
Thanks for running with me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Y-Yes—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Man, a loss is a loss, so it stings, 
but... Somehow, facing someone like 
Flash-san makes me feel like, "I've gotta 
try even harder!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. It feels great to run with her. 
She plays fair no matter what, and always 
gives it her all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"She always makes sure to come by and 
greet me like this. When she does, I've 
got no choice but to straighten up and 
mind my own manners too."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for rambling on! Anyway! I'll be 
way faster next time! So run with me 
again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! Likewise... When we have our 
rematch, I will challenge you with 
everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. I—
choice_data_list: That means you're worthy of that outfit
That means you're worthy of that outfit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Do you truly think so? That I am really 
conducting myself in a manner befitting 
this outfit—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Thank you very much. I feel like 
a weight has been lifted from my chest.

There was nothing to it. Simply put, she 
had already become an Umamusume worthy of 
carrying the nation's pride—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why... would you do that?

The "traditions" of her homeland, the ones 
most familiar to her. If she can truly 
feel that she's mastered them, it's sure 
to boost her confidence.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the recipe is steeped in the 
traditions built up over generations of 
meisters.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. In that case, I shall try 
baking it. The German cake passed down to 
me from my parents—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A Frankfurter Kranz, please.

We decided to borrow the dorm kitchen for 
the cooking, and I resolved to wait in the 
Trainer's office until it was finished.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. Next is the sugar. And then, 
mix in the butter...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...With this, the fabric is perfect. Next 
is— ............"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...Strange. When I do this, my body moves 
on its own without even thinking—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(The amount I take in my hand naturally 
turns out to be the perfect portion. 
Without even a gram of error... almost as 
if it's engraved into my body—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, I see. I'm... already—)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well then... Guten Appetit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. ...How is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you. —I'm truly, very happy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, before serving it to you, I 
had a little taste test myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is the true taste of my hometown— 
Made exactly to the recipe I've known and 
practiced since I was a child...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems 'tradition' has taken deep 
root within me, even without me having to 
tense up and force it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much, Trainer. Thanks to 
you, I feel like my doubts have cleared.
